characters.page_desc: Edit bios, manage voices, and tune per-character overrides for the player, every NPC, and your virtual entities.
characters.ve_settings.confirm_delete: Delete the virtual entity "{{name}}"? This removes the entity from VirtualEntities.yaml. The bio template file is left in place.
characters.ve_settings.empty_body: Pick a virtual entity from the sidebar to edit its config.
characters.ve_settings.entity_name.label: Entity Name
characters.ve_settings.entity_name.desc: Unique identifier for the virtual entity. Renaming may detach the existing bio template file from the entity.
characters.ve_settings.display_name.desc: Human-readable name shown in UI and logs.
characters.ve_settings.voice_id.label: Voice ID
characters.ve_settings.tts_override.desc: Override the global TTS engine for this virtual entity.
characters.ve_settings.language.label: Language Override
characters.ve_settings.language.desc: Language this entity speaks, for TTS. Leave on the inherited value to use the TTS engine's setting.
characters.ve_settings.conversation_mode: Who can perceive this entity's speech. Private = only the player; Public = NPCs nearby will react too. While Skyrim's audio engine is enabled you can hear the difference: a public entity sounds like it is in the room with you, a private one sounds like it is in your head.
characters.player_settings.heading: Player-Specific Settings
characters.player_settings.subtitle: Settings that only apply to the player character.
characters.player_settings.reactions.des: Enable or disable player thoughts and dialogue transformation system. When disabled, no automatic player responses will be generated.
characters.player_settings.memories.desc: If disabled, memories will not be generated for the player character
characters.player_settings.voice_input.d: Generate and play TTS audio for the player's dialogue. When disabled, player input is still processed but the player character remains silent (subtitles only)
characters.player_settings.voice_id.desc: Voice ID to use for player character speech synthesis
characters.player_settings.thoughts_voic: Voice ID used when the player's inner monologue is spoken aloud (the "Player Thoughts" virtual speaker).
characters.player_settings.subtitles.des: Show subtitles when the player is speaking
characters.toolbar.save_blocked_errors: Fix the bio's syntax errors before saving
characters.toolbar.copy_layer: Copy this bio into the tab you're editing
characters.version.locked_tab: This tab always edits its own layer
characters.savebios.imported_toast: Loaded bio from save {{saveId}}. Save to apply.
characters.toolbar.preview_title: Render this bio to plain text against a loaded actor's live context (resolves decorators and conditionals).
characters.sidebar.only_resolved_tip: Hide template files that don't currently match any in-game actor.
characters.sidebar.only_nearby_tip: Only show actors currently near the player.
characters.sidebar.no_characters: No characters match the current filters.
characters.empty.title: Select a character
characters.empty.body: Pick a character from the list to view or edit its bio.
characters.toast.switch_unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Discard and switch?
characters.toast.dynamic_no_bio: No dynamic bio exists for this character. Create one with Dynamic Update first.
characters.toast.save_needs_playthrough: Load a save in game to edit its save-specific bio.
characters.toast.voice_delete_no_effect: Delete didn't take effect: "{{name}}" still exists.
characters.confirm.delete_player: Delete the Player character bio? Your custom player biography will be removed. This action cannot be undone.
characters.confirm.delete_other: Delete the character "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.
characters.confirm.delete_dynamic: Delete this character's dynamic bio? The static bio is unaffected.
characters.confirm.delete_voice: Delete this custom voice file? This action cannot be undone.
characters.confirm.delete_existing_actor: Delete the existing character bio for "{{name}}"?
characters.actor.add_to_group_tip: Manage NPC group membership for this actor — add to, remove from, or create a new group.
characters.add_to_group.title: NPC Groups
characters.add_to_group.subtitle: Manage NPC group membership for {{name}}.
characters.add_to_group.empty: No groups yet — create the first one below.
characters.add_to_group.no_actor: This character has no resolved actor UUID — load them in-game first.
characters.add_to_group.delete_reserved_: The Pinned group can't be deleted
characters.add_to_group.delete_confirm: Delete the group "{{name}}"? This removes the group and all its members, and can't be undone.
characters.actor.no_data_body: No live actor data available for this character. The character may not have a corresponding actor in the game, or the actor may not be loaded.
characters.voice.title: Custom Voice
characters.voice.subtitle_player: Manage custom voice files for player character
characters.voice.unavailable_body: Generic characters cannot have custom voices.
characters.overrides.subtitle: Per-character configuration overrides
characters.overrides.no_character: Select a character to manage overrides.
characters.overrides.no_config: Select a configuration to begin editing overrides.
characters.overrides.confirm_reset_secti: Reset all overrides for this configuration section? This clears the values you've set for this section but keeps overrides from other sections.
characters.overrides.confirm_delete_all: Delete all overrides for "{{name}}"? Every section is cleared. This action cannot be undone.
characters.overrides.field_unsupported: (field type not yet supported in this editor)

characters.new_modal.target_body: This actor was found in the game but doesn't have a character bio yet.
characters.new_modal.gen_input_placehold: Provide additional context, traits, or specific requirements for AI character generation (optional)…
characters.new_modal.gen_input_hint: This input will help guide the AI in creating more personalized character bios. Leave empty for auto-generation based only on game data.
characters.new_modal.no_actors: No actors found nearby. Try increasing the search radius or moving to a different location.
characters.new_modal.has_existing: Character bio already exists for this actor
characters.new_modal.ve_body: Characters that exist only in conversation. Narrators, daedric voices, internal monologues, or any custom voice you want to speak without a body in the world.
characters.new_modal.ve_name_taken: An entity with that name already exists.
characters.update_modal.title: Update Character Bio
characters.update_modal.heading: Update Bio for: {{name}}
characters.update_modal.body: Describe what changes you want to make to this character's biography. The AI will update the existing content based on your request and current game data while preserving all character bio sections.
characters.update_modal.input_placeholde: Describe the changes you want to make to this character's bio. For example: 'Make them more mysterious and add a tragic backstory'…
characters.update_modal.input_hint: Be specific about what you want to change. The AI will preserve the complete template structure with all sections (summary, personality, background, skills, etc.) and update only the relevant content based on your request.
